cards.title: 7pm: everyone needs medicines now
cards.body: Office crowd, school parents, people on the way home. Here's how to keep the evening rush moving without cutting safety corners.

cards.title: Prep refills in the afternoon
cards.body: Pack regular patients' monthly medicines during the quiet hours. Evening pickups become a quick hand-over.

cards.title: Sort the queue smartly
cards.body: Quick refills can move fast. New prescriptions and questions get the attention they need, without holding up the whole line.

cards.title: Never skip the double-check
cards.body: The rush is when look-alike names and wrong strengths slip through. Check name, strength and quantity every time.

cards.title: Stock for the evening pattern
cards.body: Notice what moves after 6pm and keep it within easy reach of the counter.

cards.title: Still ask "kiske liye hai?"
cards.body: It takes three seconds, even on a packed evening. Worth it every single time.

cards.title: Fast is good, right is better
cards.body: Plan in the quiet hours so the rush stays smooth and safe.

takeaway: Prep refills early, sort the queue, keep evening stock handy, and never skip safety checks when it's busy.
share: Send this to the chemist whose shop turns into a mela at 7pm.
